messages:
noah: FYI I opened PR #8240 to add an `x-route-affinity` header to the TypeScript SDK. Goal: enable cheap sticky-routing without changing the route key. This will affect routing decisions, quota attribution, and the per-route dashboard. cc @ravi @claire

ravi: Nice. How is affinity different from the existing routehint / explicit routing headers?

noah: It's lightweight: server can use it as a hint to keep subsequent streaming or multi-request flows on the same worker/pool. Not authoritative routing - fallback still uses route hash. Key is we want to prevent cross-worker KV cache misses for short-lived conversational flows.

claire: Console impact: if affinity increases per-worker hotness, we might show skewed token burn per instance. We need a new dashboard dimension: `route_affinity_skew` and a per-route instance heatmap. Also show which clients set the header (helpful for migration).

eva: From SDK UX: default is *not* to send the header; it's opt-in in the client config. Example:

noah: ```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ enableRouteAffinity: true });
await client.generate({ prompt }); // sends x-route-affinity: <uuid>
```

mike: Concern: enterprises might rely on strict quota counting. If affinity keeps sending 1 slot but opens many token windows (streaming bursts), our quota model must still count tokens correctly. Do we plan to change concurrency counting?

ravi: We should keep request-concurrency semantics unchanged: affinity affects routing only, not the SLO slot count. But telemetry must emit two counters: `concurrency_slot` (unchanged) and `affinity_active_windows` (new). That way billing and alerts remain consistent.

claire: Agreed. Console: add `affinity_active_windows` to the route metrics endpoint and a toggle to include/exclude affinity clients from summarized charts. Default charts should remain identical until tenant enables affinity reporting.

eva: Migration plan: SDK will ship an opt-in beta flag. We will log an event `sdk.affinity.enabled` in telemetry when enabled. We'll also emit header `x-client-routing-mode: affinity|none`. That helps infra filter.

mike: One more: sampling. Our trace sampling currently drops low-latency streaming chunks. We should tag traces where `x-route-affinity` is present to be included in a higher-fidelity sample (for 10% extra sampling) so we can observe cache hit-rate. Ravi can we add that to ingestion?

ravi: Yes, we'll add a rule: if header present, mark trace with `affinity=true` and bump sampling weight. Need to check cost. Ops: also add an alert if `route_affinity_skew` > 0.7 for 5m.

noah: Also saw a Go SDK edge-case: older go-client (v0.9.x) strips unknown headers. We need to document that customers using the go-sdk behind proxies might lose the header. Suggest we publish middleware snippet for Go to preserve custom headers.

eva: I'll add a migration note to the TS release notes and code sample for the Go middleware. Also a quick troubleshooting checklist: 1) check header present in request traces, 2) confirm `x-client-routing-mode` event in telemetry, 3) check console heatmap.

claire: UX rollout: show a small banner on affected routes in console when >1% of requests have affinity header, link to docs. Beta users can enable the heatmap. We'll run A/B to ensure charts still make sense.

ci-bot: PR #8240 by noah opened at 2026-04-02T09:04:11Z (branch: ts/affinity, head: d4e5f6). CI: tests pending.

mike: Blocker: we need an infra e2e that simulates affinity stickiness and verifies KV cache hit improvement and no quota drift. Ravi can you own infra harness?

ravi: Yep I'll carve out time. Plan: create a small canary route with affinity opt-in, run 12h load test, measure `cache_miss_ratio` and `affinity_active_windows`.

eva: I'll prepare the release notes draft and short migration guide. Also will add a deprecation notice: if go-sdk can't forward header, we recommend upgrading or using the middleware; we'll list impact.

noah: Thanks everyone. If no objections in 48h I'll merge the PR and flip the beta flag in staging.

claire: No objections from console side. Please coordinate the increased trace sampling with billing.

ravi: Noted. Scheduling infra work for tomorrow.

noah: Great. dropping the design doc link: https://redwood.internal/doc/ts-affinity-design (private).

ci-bot: PR #8240 tests passed and merged to staging at 2026-04-02T11:22:43Z (sha: d4e5f6).
